name: Blue Carbon Ecosystems Roadmap & Action Guide
description: Launched 17 Nov 2025 at COP30 Belém by MoE & MMAF; covers mangroves, seagrass, salt marshes; 2025–2030 RENAKSI national action plan.

name: SIDAKO (KKP)
description: Ocean Accounting framework being developed for marine/coastal ecosystems and seagrass MRV integration.

name: JCM Mutual Recognition Agreement
description: Oct 2024: equivalence between JCM credits and SPE-GRK; 51 JCM projects already in Indonesia.

name: Verra–SRN MRA
description: Aligns Verra VCS with SRN registration requirements.

name: MoF Regulation No. 6/2026
description: Ministry of Finance regulation operationalising the Letter of Authorization (LoA) procedure for ITMO transfers under PR 110/2025. Defines submission, fiscal, and reporting requirements for Art.6.2 corresponding adjustments.

name: SRUK (Sistem Registri Unit Karbon)
description: ITMO sub-registry for international transfers established under PR 110/2025. Operates alongside SRN-PPI; SRUK records authorized credits, corresponding adjustments and cancellation events.

name: SRN-PPI (Sistem Registri Nasional PPI)
description: Public national registry for greenhouse gas emission reduction certificates (SPE-GRK), administered by MoE / DGCCC. Hosts non-ITMO and pre-ITMO project records.
